desc: Build adjacency list and root the tree at 1.
Implement post-order DFS returning `down_any[u]` and `down_has4[u]` for each node u given its parent.

In the post-order DFS, for each node u, collect the `down_any` values of its children, compute the sum of the largest 3 if there are at least 3 children, and set `down_any[u] = max(1, 1 + sum_top3)` and `down_has4[u] = 1 + sum_top3` (or -inf if fewer than 3 children).

Implement pre-order DFS to compute `up_any[u]` and `up_has4[u]` for each non-root node u (the contributions from the parent side when u is the child) and then compute `best_rooted[u]` using all neighbors (children and parent).

For each node u, consider it as the root of the alkane subgraph: try leaf (exactly 1 child, using `has4` from that child) and internal (exactly 4 children, using `any` from those children), and take the maximum over all nodes.
Output the maximum size found, or -1 if no valid alkane exists.
